usedFor: mindStudio runs your AI apps, where “Load an app” lists them and “Run Workflow” starts one and opens a thread.

bestTemplate.name: “Run Workflow” in mindStudio
bestTemplate.why: It runs a workflow and creates a new thread, so an event can start an AI app.

watchOut: “Run Workflow” starts a workflow in one of your mindStudio apps, so pick the right app and workflow.
